{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured wool-blend skirt, midi length, forest green #2E4836, heavy felt.
A crisp silk-cotton blouse, relaxed fit with a彼得潘领, ivory white #FFFFF0, woven cotton-silk blend.
A tailored wool trench coat, knee-length, charcoal gray #36454F, gabardine fabric.
Leather ankle boots, block heel, chocolate brown #4B3621, smooth calfskin leather.
Thin gold bar necklace, oxidized copper finish, lightweight metal chain.
This ensemble works because it balances the professional requirements of an office setting with the specific wish to wear a skirt. The midi length and structured wool fabric provide warmth suitable for autumn weather while maintaining a polished, neat silhouette. Earthy tones in green, brown, and gray create a cohesive and sophisticated look that transitions effortlessly from morning meetings to after-work errands without sacrificing comfort or style."}
